method.observation: One priced common-stock holding over one completed public-filing execution window.
method.execution: Use the first tradable SPY date on or after each 13F filing date; measure through the next filing execution date.
method.win: Holding price return is greater than SPY price return over the identical filing-to-filing window.
method.payoffRatio: Average positive excess return divided by the absolute average negative excess return.
method.bigAdd: New common-stock position or at least 50% quarter-over-quarter increase in reported shares, ending at 10% or more of the priced disclosed long copy book.
method.taxonomy: Analyst-defined stable clusters built from Sharadar SF1 sector and industry labels; FWONK is manually mapped to Internet, media & gaming.
method.exclusions: Options, shorts, cash, private assets, unpriced/non-ticker rows, incomplete current window, dividends, fees, taxes and slippage.
method.limitation: This is a delayed disclosed-long-book proxy. It is not Gavin Baker personal performance or Atreides fund performance.
